result.summary: No critical blockers are visible. The page generally renders correctly, with a few minor layout/accessibility concerns around horizontally clipped carousel content and small/secondary text clarity.

issues.description: In the “Fastest near you” carousel, the third restaurant card is clipped at the right edge and its name appears truncated as “Trattoria Piccol…” without a clear ellipsis or strong scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer horizontal scroll indication, increase the peek amount of the next card, or ensure truncated titles use ellipses consistently within the visible card area.

issues.description: The notification bell shows a red unread dot but appears to rely on color/shape alone and may not expose an accessible label such as “Notifications, 1 unread.”
issues.suggestion: Add an accessible content description/label for the bell and include unread count semantics for assistive technologies.

issues.description: Some secondary metadata text such as delivery fees, time ranges, and category chips is small and gray, which may be harder to read in bright outdoor conditions.
issues.suggestion: Slightly increase font size and/or contrast for secondary metadata while preserving the visual hierarchy.
